title: Road hauliers’ convoy protest in Zagreb

execution.observed: Reports give roughly 150–200 trucks moving in the city. Drivers in operating trucks establish a large visible group but truck count is not human headcount; no exact person number. Demands concerned ministry rules for border routing, chamber membership, parafiscal fees and pandemic business aid. HRT carries Hina origin; treat as source dependence.
